title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
**Job Summary**

The Assistant Team Lead / Team Lead will lead an underwriting operations team, driving quality risk assessment, productivity, SLA adherence, and process compliance. The role combines underwriting expertise with people management and client handling, requiring someone who can mentor a team while owning outcomes for key stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Underwriters to consistently meet productivity, quality, and TAT targets
* Own day\-to\-day team handling — workload allocation, shift planning, attendance, and performance tracking
* Review underwriting decisions for compliance with company guidelines and risk appetite
* Ensure accurate risk assessment aligned to underwriting policy and regulatory standards
* Track daily productivity, quality scores, and SLA/KPI performance
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions
* Own client relationships — handle queries, join client calls/reviews, and resolve client escalations with clear root\-cause analysis
* Resolve complex underwriting escalations, both internal and client\-facing
* Spot process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives
* Prepare and analyze MIS reports and quality dashboards
* Coordinate with Quality, Training, Operations, and Business teams
* Support hiring, onboarding, and capability building within the team
* Ensure compliance with audit and process requirements
* Build team engagement and a high\-performance culture

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in Life Insurance Underwriting Operations within an Insurance BPO environment.
* Exposure to either UK or US Insurance Operations is preferred but not mandatory.
* Strong grounding in underwriting principles, including medical underwriting, financial underwriting, fraud detection/indicators, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, decision\-making, and communication skills.

**Key Skills**

* Underwriting expertise and risk decision\-making
* Team leadership and people management
* Client handling and escalation management
* Analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Strong verbal and written communication
* Coaching, mentoring, and stakeholder management
* Advanced Excel and MIS reporting
* Process and quality improvement

**KPIs**

* Team productivity \| Underwriting quality \& accuracy \| TAT \| SLA adherence
* Audit \& compliance scores \| Client satisfaction \| Escalation resolution
* Employee engagement \| Training effectiveness \| Process improvement impact
* Preferred Competencies
* Ownership mindset with strong leadership presence
* Customer\-centric, client\-facing orientation
* High attention to detail under pressure
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities and stakeholders
* Flexibility to support business priorities

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹550,000\.00 per year

* Provident Fund

title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**



Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

#### **The Role**



Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.



As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.



Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


#### **What You'll Do**


* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.

#### **Who You Are**


* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

 **Our Values**


* **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.



PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Sr. Manager Operations - Plant Head

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and employee engagement.

This is an opportunity to lead a strategically important manufacturing facility, influence business growth, and drive operational excellence while developing high\-performing teams in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.

title: Deputy Plant Manager
description:
**About JLG, an Oshkosh company**

**JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.**

**Job Summary**


The Deputy Plant Manager is a key member of the Pune site leadership team, responsible for supporting the safe, efficient and effective operation of the manufacturing facility.


Working closely with the Plant Manager, the role will lead day\-to\-day manufacturing performance while playing a key role in the continued growth and development of the Pune operation. The successful candidate will help build the people, processes, capabilities and infrastructure required to support a rapidly growing manufacturing facility, with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost and customer satisfaction.


This is an opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to make a significant impact within a growing operation and a global manufacturing organisation.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support the Plant Manager in the overall leadership and management of the Pune manufacturing facility, assuming site leadership responsibilities as required.
* Lead manufacturing operations to achieve targets across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost and employee engagement.
* Monitor production performance, labour, capacity, materials and operating costs, taking timely action to address performance gaps.
* Establish strong daily and weekly operating disciplines, performance measures and accountability processes.
* Play a key role in scaling the Pune facility to support future business growth, including workforce, capacity, equipment, layout and infrastructure requirements.
* Support the introduction and industrialisation of new products, manufacturing processes, equipment and production capabilities.
* Champion a strong safety and quality culture and ensure compliance with company standards and applicable requirements.
* Drive Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement and structured problem solving to improve operational performance.
* Support capital investment planning and business cases for equipment, technology and infrastructure required to support growth and productivity.
* Develop and coach manufacturing leaders, supervisors and team members, building the capability required for a growing organisation.
* Partner closely with HR on workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, employee engagement and talent development.
* Work collaboratively with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and other functions to deliver business objectives.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to share best practices and support broader operational initiatives.
* Provide clear updates to senior leadership on plant performance, priorities, risks and improvement actions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing operations and delivering improvements across safety, quality, delivery, cost and productivity.
* Strong understanding of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement and structured problem solving.
* Experience leading teams through operational growth, change or increasing manufacturing complexity.
* Strong communication, people leadership, analytical and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and within a global organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a global or multinational manufacturing organisation.
* Experience in heavy equipment, automotive, industrial machinery, off\-highway or another complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting the start\-up, expansion or significant scaling of a manufacturing operation.
* Experience with new product introduction, industrialisation or capacity expansion.
* Experience developing manufacturing leaders and building high\-performing teams.
* Experience in Logisitcs and import/export compliance

**Oshkosh Leadership Traits**


The successful candidate will demonstrate the Oshkosh Leadership Traits through the way they lead people, manage the operation and support the growth of the business.

**Inspires Vision and Purpose \-** Connects day\-to\-day priorities to the broader business direction and creates energy around the future of the Pune operation.

**Instills Trust \-** Leads with honesty, integrity and transparency, follows through on commitments and builds dependable relationships.

**Fosters Engagement \-** Empowers people, develops capability, recognises contribution and creates an environment where teams are motivated to perform at their best.

**Cultivates Innovation \-** Challenges the status quo, encourages new and better ways of working and uses diverse perspectives and technology to improve performance.

**Customer Focus \-** Builds customer ownership throughout the operation and ensures manufacturing decisions support evolving customer needs and expectations.

**Drives Results \-** Creates accountability and urgency, removes barriers and consistently delivers meaningful results, even in challenging circumstances.

**Working Conditions**

* Based at the Pune manufacturing facility, with a strong presence required within manufacturing and operational areas.
* Flexibility to support operational requirements outside normal working hours when required.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.

title: Manager-Operations
description:
“130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers \- built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200\+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.”
  
**Job Description :** Manager Operations \-US Life Insurance
  
**Location:** Pune, India
  
**Work Model:** Work from Office
  
**Shift:** US Night Shift
  
**Function:** Insurance Operations / Client Delivery
  
  

**Role Overview :**  

We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Manager Insurance Operations to lead end\-to\-end operations for a strategic insurance client. This is a high\-impact leadership role requiring a strong combination of Insurance domain expertise ( Life, Retail, Commercial insurance ), operational leadership, client management, project/program management, transition management, automation, business development support and executive communication. The successful candidate will be responsible not only for ensuring operational excellence and meeting agreed service levels, but also for identifying opportunities to transform the operation, improve customer experience, drive automation, support new business pursuits and lead strategic initiatives for the client. The individual should be equally comfortable running the business, improving the business and engaging confidently with senior client stakeholders and CXO\-level audiences.
  
  

**Required Qualifications ExperienceEssential:**  

10\+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Insurance operations ( Life / Retail / Commercial ). Strong experience managing US Insurance / Life Annuity operations / Retail / Commercial. Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end operations across the Life / Retail / Commercial Insurance value chain. Strong understanding of US Insurance products, processes and policy lifecycle. Proven experience managing large teams and multiple operational processes. Demonstrated experience in client\-facing roles with senior US stakeholders. Proven experience in managing operational SLAs, KPIs, quality and productivity. Demonstrated experience in new client transitions / migrations. Demonstrated experience in building teams from scratch and scaling them. Demonstrated experience in driving automation and process transformation with measurable outcomes. Strong project management / program management experience. Proven experience creating new business proposals, RFP responses and client presentations. Excellent PowerPoint presentation and storytelling skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities. Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity and make sound business decisions. Willingness to work in a US night shift environment. Willingness to work 100% from office.
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

Bachelors degree in Business, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree / MBA preferred.
  
State Insurance Adjuster / Claims Adjuster certification or relevant US state insurance licensing .
  
LOMA / FLMI / ALMI or equivalent Life Insurance certification preferred.
  
Lean Six Sigma certification preferred. PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification preferred. Experience working with Life Insurance policy administration platforms such as Guidewire, Majesco, Sapiens, Vitech, FAST, Oracle/legacy PAS platforms or similar is desirable. Exposure to RPA, AI/GenAI, workflow automation, process mining and analytics tools is preferred. Experience working with US clients and understanding US insurance operating models is strongly preferred.
  
105457 \| Operations \| Management \| Non\-Executive \| Allianz Services \| Full\-Time \| Permanent
  
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  

**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prospous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
  
  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  

Great to have you on board.Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Manager - Customer Service Operations
description:
**Role:** Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN L3 Engineer / SME **Location:** Pune **Experience:** 7–10\+ years (3–5 years Catalyst SD‑WAN mandatory)


**Job Summary**



Hiring an experienced **Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN L3 Engineer** with strong hands‑on expertise in **vManage, SD‑WAN Controllers, Catalyst SD‑WAN Edge**, overlay/underlay design, OMP, centralized/data policies, segmentation, and advanced routing. The role involves complex SD‑WAN deployments, L3 escalations, WAN migrations, and performance optimization for enterprise networks.


**Key Responsibilities**



✔️ Deploy, configure \& troubleshoot **Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN** (vManage, Controllers, Catalyst SD‑WAN Edge) ✔️ Lead **L3 escalation handling**, fabric outages, tunnel issues, OMP \& policy failures ✔️ Design hybrid WAN (MPLS \+ Internet \+ LTE) and optimize routing ✔️ Migrate legacy MPLS/VPN networks to Catalyst SD‑WAN ✔️ Tune App‑Aware routing, QoS, segmentation \& centralized/localized policies ✔️ Perform RCA, upgrades, patches \& lifecycle management ✔️ Prepare HLD/LLD, SOPs, runbooks \& follow ITIL processes


**Required Skills**



 Hands‑on expertise in Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN architecture \& components Strong in OMP, control/data policies, routing \& segmentation Protocols: BGP, OSPF, VRF, IPSec Tools: SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG Basic firewall knowledge (Fortinet / Palo Alto / ASA / Checkpoint) Strong troubleshooting using PCAP, logs, control connections


**Preferred Certifications**



 Cisco SD‑WAN Specialist (Catalyst SD‑WAN) CCNP Enterprise / Security CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure / Security (added advantage) ITIL Foundation

title: AM Customer Care
description:
### **About Us**


At Kohler, our mission is to help people live gracious, healthy, and sustainable lives. We believe that empowering our associates is essential to making this vision a reality. That’s why we invest in personal and professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams and functions, and offer a comprehensive wellness package that supports the well\-being of every team member.


Kohler is an equal opportunity employer. Along with competitive compensation and benefits, we offer something more enduring—a legacy built on bold innovation, creative excellence, and a deep commitment to our people and communities. Learn more about our culture and career opportunities at www.kohler.co.in/careers.


Our approach to hiring reflects our commitment to **Global Inclusion**. We recruit, hire, and promote qualified individuals in all roles without regard to race, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, or disability. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you appropriately.


  
Job Description:
Kohler Co.'s mission is to contribute to a higher level of gracious living for those who are touched by our products and services.


Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities. We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com


It is Kohler’s policy to recruit, hire, and promote qualified personnel in all job classifications without regard to race, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Kohler Co. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.


**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place to Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by \- every day.**

  

**Position Description**


**Position Title**

  

AM – Customer Care

  

  

**Department**

  

Customer Services

  

  

**Division**

  

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

  

  

**Grade**

  

AM

  

  

**Reporting to**

Manager – Customer Care

  

  

**About the position:**

We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).


As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.


**Role and Responsibility:**


**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**. Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.

  

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.

**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.
* Experience working in the manufacturing industry is preferred.
  

This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.


**Working Conditions:**


This is a full\-time role based in our customer service Pune office. The includes evenings and weekends working to meet customer demands, as we operate 24/7\. You'll work six days a week with rotating shifts and weekly offs. Occasional travel for business may also be required.


**Organizational Relationships:**

* Reports to Manager – Customer Care,
* Regular interactions with business stakeholders from different Kohler business verticals at ITC
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.
Mandatory Skills:
Team Management, Escalation Management, People Leadership, Inbound Voice Process, Data Analytics, Reports and Dashboards


Location:
Magarpatta, Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra, India


Experience:
12 to 15 years
